sql_templates.query: WITH recent_highs AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(close) AS recent_high FROM market.equity_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY symbol), vcp_candidates AS (SELECT v.symbol, v.company_name, v.enhanced_fund_score FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks v WHERE v.enhanced_fund_score >= 70 AND v.snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'), breakout_candidates AS (SELECT e.symbol FROM market.equity_eod e JOIN recent_highs h ON e.symbol = h.symbol WHERE e.close = h.recent_high AND e.trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') SELECT vc.symbol, vc.company_name, vc.enhanced_fund_score FROM vcp_candidates vc JOIN breakout_candidates bc ON vc.symbol = bc.symbol;
